literature_search_status: exploratory scoping search; formal database searches remain required by thematic front
governing_decisions: The 18 AraLearn resources are legacy seeds, not an ARA ontology.
Representation, activity, response, validation, feedback, runtime and rendering must be separately typed.
Courses may reference only installed and approved capabilities; course JSON must not supply executable component code.
Video remains outside the baseline; optional speech rendering is not a canonical audio resource.
Repository capabilities are technical precedents, not evidence of educational effectiveness.

interpretation: The benchmark is sufficient to reject flashcard platform as the comprehensive genre of ARA and to define first-principles redesign work. It does not select a final stack or establish effectiveness.
